digest.component_or_area: enrichment queue and digest history retention
propositions: Physical deletion of committed UUID events does not reclaim git repository space but breaks cross-clone merges via rename detection pairing, creating unresolved CONFLICT (rename/rename) wedges
Unbounded file opens in `_events_of` scale with event history; the queue reduction is latest-wins per type, enabling a bounded suffix-lazy read that costs zero bytes and fixes the asymptote
Filename lexicographic order equals event timestamp order by construction, permitting newest-first traversal with immediate parse-fail fallback to satisfy merge-safety invariant I1 unchanged
A merge-safe removal must rename to deterministic source-derived paths with identical content; removal paired with fresh-UUID adds is never merge-safe and violates invariant I1
Read-only design change (no deletion, rename, or write) cannot regress existing two-clone reconvergence regression; the suffix-lazy reader is deferred to follow-up ea2a-1571-efdc-4447
